props.title: What Is a Body Scrub?
props.text: A body scrub is an exfoliating treatment that removes dead skin cells and everyday buildup, leaving skin smoother. In Bali, sun, salt water, humidity and time outdoors can leave skin dry or dull. Our therapists use natural scrubs inspired by traditional Balinese lulur to refresh it gently.
props.feature1Text: Available in chocolate, coconut, strawberry, bengkoang, jasmine, green tea, and Spa Sari variants.
props.feature2Text: Comfortable exfoliation using fine natural scrub ingredients and controlled pressure.

props.title: Body Scrub Packages in Seminyak
props.text: Each of our four body scrub packages pairs a 30-minute scrub with a Balinese, Thai, hot stone or warm candle massage and a Bali Moon Facial, cream bath or head massage.

props.title: Body Scrub Options
props.text: All seven scrubs are the same full-body treatment at the same price; choose the scent you like. An extra body mask can be applied after the scrub, followed by a shower.

props.title: Body Scrub Benefits
props.text: A regular body scrub refreshes the skin and leaves it smoother. What it does:
featuresLeft: Helps remove dead skin cells and buildup
May improve the appearance of dry areas
featuresRight: Helps moisturisers and body oils absorb better
Helps maintain softer and brighter-looking skin

props.title: When to Book a Body Scrub
props.text: A body scrub is a good idea:
featuresLeft: When your skin feels rough or dull
featuresRight: As part of your regular skincare routine

props.title: What Happens During Your Body Scrub
props.text: You choose your scrub, then your therapist works it over your whole body with gentle circular movements, giving extra time to rough areas such as elbows, knees and feet. The scrub is then rinsed off, leaving your skin smoother and cleaner.
featuresRight: Available for spa and home service bookings

props.title: Choose Your Natural Scrub
props.text: Every scrub exfoliates just as gently; they differ in scent and in what they bring to your skin.
featuresLeft: Chocolate for a rich nourishing experience
featuresRight: Green Tea for a calming treatment
Jasmine and Spa Sari for a traditional aromatic experience

items.question: What happens during a body scrub?
items.answer: During a body scrub at Spa Bali Moon, your therapist applies your chosen natural scrub with gentle circular motions to lift away dead skin cells, often giving extra attention to elbows, knees and feet. After rinsing, it may be followed by a moisturising lotion, body oil or relaxing massage.

items.question: What are the benefits of a full body scrub?
items.answer: A full body scrub at Spa Bali Moon removes dead skin cells from the surface, leaving skin smoother, softer and fresher. Done regularly, it gives skin a brighter look and helps moisturisers absorb better.

items.question: How often should I get a body scrub?
items.answer: Most guests choose a body scrub every one to two weeks to keep their skin smooth. In Bali, many also book one after beach days or before a special occasion.

items.question: Will a body scrub feel rough on my skin?
items.answer: No. Spa Bali Moon's body scrub uses fine natural exfoliants inspired by traditional Balinese lulur, applied with gentle circular movements and controlled pressure, so the treatment stays comfortable while still exfoliating effectively.

items.question: Is a body scrub suitable for dry skin?
items.answer: Yes. A body scrub removes dead surface buildup, which often allows moisturisers and body oils to absorb more effectively, helping dry skin feel softer and more hydrated afterwards. At Spa Bali Moon, the coconut scrub is a good choice for moisture and softness, and an additional body mask can be added for IDR 100.000.

items.question: Can I get a body scrub after spending time in the sun?
items.answer: Yes, a body scrub is fine after sun, provided your skin is not sunburnt or overly sensitive. Many guests book one at Spa Bali Moon after beach days or outdoor activities to remove buildup and refresh skin left dry or dull by sun and salt water.

items.question: Can a body scrub help with body acne or clogged pores?
items.answer: A body scrub is not a treatment for acne. Regular exfoliation lifts away the dead skin cells that can clog pores, and many guests at Spa Bali Moon find their skin feels cleaner and smoother afterwards.

items.question: How much does a body scrub cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A body scrub at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak is IDR 169.000 per person, whichever of the seven scents you choose. An additional body mask is IDR 100.000. Four packages from IDR 485.000 per person add a massage, facial, hot stone or cream bath. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: Where can I get a body scrub in Seminyak?
items.answer: You can get a body scrub at Spa Bali Moon, Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30, Seminyak, open daily from 9am to 11pm, or at your villa or hotel for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: How long does a body scrub take?
items.answer: A body scrub at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 30 to 60 minutes and costs IDR 169.000 per person, in any of seven scents. In a spa package the scrub is the shorter 30-minute version, so the whole visit takes less time.

items.question: Can I have a body scrub at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen and everything a body scrub needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta.

items.question: Can I book a body scrub for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my body scrub?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your body scrub on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

props.title: Give Your Skin a Fresh Start After Days in the Bali Sun
props.text: Beach days and Bali sun leave skin dry and rough. Our body scrub lifts away dead skin and leaves it smoother and softer. At our spa, or at your villa or hotel.
props.closingText: Reserve your appointment and enjoy refreshed, smoother-feeling skin.
